name: The Windshaper's Wrath
summary: Lumina Windsinger asks you to help her escape Fenris Keep. Your aid gives her reason to trust paladins.

sections.title: A Way Out
sections.body: Lumina Windsinger is free inside Fenris Keep, but she wants to leave with you. She means to make the creatures who held her regret crossing a Windshaper. Stay with her as she makes her escape.

sections.title: A New Friend
sections.body: At Fenris Keep, Lumina tells you she has met Trevan and learned he sent you to find her. She has heard unkind things about paladins, but your help has changed her view. The Windshapers count you and your kind as friends.

faq.answer: Lumina Windsinger is a Windshaper who was held at Fenris Keep and seeks your help escaping.

faq.q: Where is Lumina trying to escape from?
faq.answer: Lumina Windsinger is trying to escape Fenris Keep.

faq.q: Who sent me to find Lumina?
faq.answer: Lumina says Trevan sent you along her trail.
Lumina has heard unkind things about paladins, but says those claims proved unfounded after your help.

faq.q: What does Lumina think of me?
faq.answer: Lumina says you and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.

angles.text: As a paladin, Lumina has heard unkind things about your kind, but your help gives her cause to welcome you as a friend.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Windshaper's Wrath
